research_rejections.title: The Thaw
research_rejections.reason: Arctic ecologists uncover a prehistoric parasite in thawing mammoth remains, providing a strong biology-and-research premise. Across the complete film, however, the central structure shifts toward gruesome infestation, quarantine, interpersonal conflict and escape, including deliberate release of the organism; continued scientific testing and progressive rule discovery are secondary. Identity and premise: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1235448/plotsummary/ ; whole-film structure and ending: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1235448/plotsummary/ ; independent reception: https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/thaw .

research_rejections.title: The Last Days on Mars
research_rejections.reason: A Mars research crew discovers evidence of microbial life, but infection rapidly transforms people into aggressive zombie-like threats. Whole-film coverage confirms the story becomes predominantly crew survival, pursuit and containment rather than sustained organism research or systematic revelation of an unknown system. Identity and detailed plot: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1709143/plotsummary/ ; substantive whole-film criticism: https://www.rogerebert.com/reviews/the-last-days-on-mars-2013 and https://www.thewrap.com/last-days-mars-review-stylish-sci-fi-monster-movie-cant-decide-high-art-fun-trash/ .
